title: 1798 Revolt of the Alfaiates
text: The Bahian Conspiracy, also known as Revolt of the Tailors–after the trade of many of the leaders–and recently also called Revolt of Buzios, was a late eighteenth century slave rebellion in the then Captaincy of Bahia, in the State of Brazil. Unlike the Inconfidência Mineira of 1789, it was a separatist movement with a popular base and extensive black participation.
